|lore=One of Xizor’s hand-picked lieutenants. Ascended as Black Sun agent from gangster to manager. Earned title of Vigo, from old Tionese for ‘nephew.’<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Deploys for free on Coruscant. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a non-Coruscant battleground site and Vengeance Of The Dark Prince is on table, Force drain +1 here. Forfeit +2 when present with Xizor or another Vigo.<ref name="foil-face" />
